preview.//: Free tier. Android -> sideloadable .apk. iOS -> .app for the Simulator (no Apple account needed).

env.//: The deployed API. Point this at a LAN address only when testing against a dev server.

device.//: Installable on real iPhones. Requires a paid Apple Developer account for signing.

production.//: Store submissions: Android .aab, iOS .ipa. Neither can be installed by hand.
